title: ‘Why Do You Ask Me? Ask Someone Who Knows Chassidus!’
blurb: When Yerucham Garelik asked him for pshat in his father's maamar , the yet-to-be Frierdiker Rebbe played unlearned. But then R. Avrohom Elye Plotkin caught him writing an explanation on the question, and advised Yerucham to extract it from him.
